SAFETY: the butcher's knife may only ever lie flat on the chopping block as a quiet work tool — never raised, never held blade-forward, never glinting, never near a person. No blood, no wounds, no whole animals. The meat is always neat wrapped parcels or plain dark-red slabs on the block

cast.proud: THE PROUD NOBLEMAN — a Joseon yangban in his forties, chin tilted up and eyes looking down his nose, thin arched eyebrows and a neat black moustache, black horsehair gat hat, glossy deep-indigo silk durumagi coat, always carrying a folding fan
cast.polite: THE POLITE NOBLEMAN — a Joseon yangban of the same age, round gentle face with soft smiling eyes and a short beard, black horsehair gat hat, plain warm-grey silk durumagi coat, hands usually clasped politely in front of him
cast.butcher: PARK SANG-GIL — the old village butcher, in his sixties, weathered kind face with a short white beard and deep laugh lines, white cloth headband tied round his head, white hemp jeogori with the sleeves rolled up, dark work apron
